answer: A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a farm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The falcon cap is enforced at intake and crystal reveals the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a anchor tag. That is 9 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
